AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: The Android home screen launcher. Opens apps, runs command bar commands, calculates and reads the home screen panel. Operational Patterns: - Call 'searchApps' first when the app name is uncertain, then call 'openApp' with the exact name. - 'runCommand' accepts the command bar syntax: 'abrir [app]', 'alarme HH:MM', 'calc [expression]', 'rota [place]', 't [task]', plus the user's aliases (see 'listAliases'). Constraints: - Commands that call a contact or send a message are never run; 'runCommand' answers NEEDS_CONFIRMATION and the user must confirm on the device. - The launcher does not change settings through these functions.
